analytical_errors_identified.claim: Macro mIoU masking and artificial compression caused by single-scene rare classes in DEV ... mathematically capping macro mIoU at ~0.05.
analytical_errors_identified.scientific_rebuttal: The primary metric is the arithmetic macro mean of class IoUs over classes 1..11. Sparse class support (1, 2, or 3 DEV scenes) does not mathematically cap a class IoU at any fixed value, nor does it mathematically cap macro mIoU at ~0.05. Rare support creates high estimator variance, instability, and extreme sensitivity to individual scenes, which is a measurement-support concern, not a deterministic arithmetic upper bound.

analytical_errors_identified.claim: Labeling MCC and IWs as 'Stable Strength'.
analytical_errors_identified.scientific_rebuttal: Calling a class 'stable' conflates high observed mean IoU with low between-seed variability. MCC has high observed mean (0.257 C, 0.212 T) and high DEV support (17 scenes, 33.35% pixels), but seed variability is present (SD 0.028 C, 0.047 T). IWs has observed mean 0.104 C vs 0.229 T with SD 0.052 C. High mean performance must be distinguished from between-seed stability.

analytical_errors_identified.claim: Causal phrasing: 'Why the Loss-Weight Intervention Yielded Net Zero' and 'Uniform weighting did not improve representation learning.'
analytical_errors_identified.scientific_rebuttal: The experiment evaluated task segmentation performance (dev_mIoU_phenomena and class IoUs) under a locked protocol, not internal representations directly. The phrase must be calibrated to observed trade-offs: 'Observed Class-Level Trade-Off Associated With the Loss-Weight Intervention' and 'Uniform weighting did not produce a robust aggregate DEV advantage in the five-pair study.'

analytical_errors_identified.claim: Assuming a 'Single-Channel Information Bottleneck' in Rank 3 and 'stochastic starvation' causality in Rank 2.
analytical_errors_identified.scientific_rebuttal: Modality limitations and sampler effects must be framed as testable diagnostic hypotheses. Rank 3 must assess whether class-conditional backscatter distributions exhibit substantial overlap that could plausibly limit discriminability. Rank 2 must evaluate whether realized sampling schedules produce materially different class/parent exposures across seeds associated with observed variance, without asserting causal starvation.

validated_prioritized_diagnostic_roadmap.title: Class-Support Stratification and Primary Metric Sensitivity Diagnostic
validated_prioritized_diagnostic_roadmap.diagnostic_question: Does DEV class-support imbalance make the primary macro-mIoU estimate disproportionately sensitive to a small number of physical acquisitions, and how much does the interpretation change when results are stratified by class support?
validated_prioritized_diagnostic_roadmap.target_failure: Disproportionate sensitivity of unweighted macro mIoU to sparse-support classes in DEV (e.g. OF in 1 sample, RF in 2 samples, HM in 3 samples), where individual acquisitions have high leverage on class-level estimates.
validated_prioritized_diagnostic_roadmap.scientific_justification: Directly addresses evaluation-level uncertainty on existing predictions without retraining or modifying benchmarks. Disentangles broad model behavior from single-scene estimator volatility while maintaining the frozen primary metric authoritative.
candidate_analyses: Macro mIoU by support strata (high-support vs sparse-support vs zero-support DEV classes)
Per-class IoU vs number of DEV parent acquisitions
Per-parent acquisition contribution to class support
Support-weighted descriptive summaries as secondary diagnostics (never replacing primary metric)

validated_prioritized_diagnostic_roadmap.title: Candidate F Sampler Schedule Exposure and Seed-Variance Audit
validated_prioritized_diagnostic_roadmap.diagnostic_question: Does the realized Candidate F sampling schedule produce materially different class/parent exposure patterns across seeds that are associated with the observed performance variance?
validated_prioritized_diagnostic_roadmap.target_failure: High between-seed performance volatility on moderately rare classes (BS spans 0.018 to 0.158; POW spans 0.003 to 0.102 across identical seeds).
validated_prioritized_diagnostic_roadmap.scientific_justification: Analyzes offline combinatorial draw realizations across seeds to assess whether realized draw differences correlate descriptively with validation variance, without altering the sampler or claiming causal starvation.
candidate_analyses: Cumulative per-class tile draw counts across 30 epochs for Seeds 42, 101, 202, 303, 404
Per-parent cluster exposure counts across epochs
Correlation between realized draw count and best-epoch class IoU

validated_prioritized_diagnostic_roadmap.title: Single-Band VV SAR Radiometric Contrast and Distributional Overlap Diagnostic
validated_prioritized_diagnostic_roadmap.diagnostic_question: Assess whether class-conditional backscatter distributions in the available single-band VV input exhibit substantial overlap that could plausibly limit discriminability.
validated_prioritized_diagnostic_roadmap.target_failure: Persistent near-zero IoU on RF, HM, and lower observed performance on dark-slick classes (WS, LWA) under uniform loss.
validated_prioritized_diagnostic_roadmap.scientific_justification: Tests physical hypothesis of backscatter distribution overlap from existing GeoTIFFs without assuming an 'information bottleneck' prior to empirical measurement.
candidate_analyses: Class-conditional DN and log1p backscatter histograms inside mask polygons
Signal-to-clutter ratio (SCR) for point/boundary targets (HM, RF)
Pairwise Bhattacharyya distance / histogram overlap between dark-slick classes (WS, BS, LWA)
